# Acme Industries — Master Services Agreement 2026
Reference MSA-2026-0117
Vendor / Supplier agreement

## Parties
1. **Acme Industries, Inc.** (Illinois, IL-58201377) — "the Customer"
2. **Cardstack Inc.** (Delaware, DE-7241188) — "the Supplier"

## Term and value
This agreement is effective from 15 Jul 2026 and ends on 14 Jul 2027 (12 months).
It renews automatically for successive terms of 12 months unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the then-current term — for the current term, by **15 May 2027**.
Total contract value: **$5,880.00**.

## Terms
### 1. Payment Terms — Net 30
Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt of a valid invoice.

### 2. Liability Cap — 12 Months' Fees
> **Deviation from playbook** (major) — Counterparty refused the cap for data-breach claims. Conceded in exchange for Net-30 and a 12-month term rather than 24. Raises composite risk and adds an executive approval step.
Supplier's aggregate liability shall be unlimited in respect of any breach of clause 9 (Data Protection), and otherwise capped at the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

### 3. Data protection
> **Deviation from playbook** (bespoke) — No approved standard covers a pre-authorised sub-processor list. Flagged for legal review before the next renewal.
Supplier may engage the sub-processors listed at Schedule 4 without further authorisation, provided it remains liable for their acts and omissions.

### 4. Auto-Renewal — 12 Months, 60-Day Notice
This Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives not less than sixty (60) days' written notice before the end of the then-current term.

## Governing law and disputes
This agreement is governed by the law of **Delaware**; disputes are submitted to **Delaware Court of Chancery**. (Delaware / Delaware Court of Chancery)
Executives to meet within 15 business days of a written dispute notice before either party files. Proceedings in English.
